text: The U.S. 30-year Treasury yield reached about 5.44%, its highest since 2004, while the 10-year remained near 5.10% after reaching a 2007 high. Japanese, U.K. and German sovereign yields also reached multiyear or multidecade highs.

meta.note: Maturities and sovereign markets share elevated yields without uniform magnitude or timing.

text: Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson said modest additional tightening may be warranted after the FOMC raised the federal funds target to 3.75%-4%. She placed underlying inflation near 2.5%-3%, above the Fed's 2% target.

meta.note: Further tightening is conditional rather than an announced policy action.

text: Judge Timothy Kelly temporarily blocked enforcement of the White House ban and ordered CNN, MS NOW and Politico credentials restored for 14 days. After reporters were initially denied entry Thursday, the White House restored their access.

meta.note: The access restoration is temporary while the underlying litigation remains unresolved.
